verdict.rationale: Moss is a semantic search runtime and cloud service, so self-hosted Kubernetes deployment via a Helm chart or operator is a fair question for it. The evidence covers SDKs, a CLI, an MCP server, and browser, on-device and cloud runtimes, but never mentions Kubernetes, a Helm chart or an operator.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can deploy to production on Kubernetes with an official Helm chart or operator
